intent: Disclosure list for short related sections: one open at a time, or several with type multiple.
useWhen: FAQ or help copy grouped under short titles
Settings or detail blocks the user opens one at a time, or several side by side with type multiple
doNotUseWhen: A single show/hide block — use Collapsible
Page grouping under a heading — use Section (collapsible if it folds)

items.note: content is the panel body: a string or kit pieces such as a Field or Table. meta is short secondary text at the end of the header. count renders a neutral kit Count at the end of the header, before meta. disabled shows the header but it cannot toggle. Header: md control height (36); ChevronRight 16px first, turning down when open; 14/20 title at 550; Count then meta grouped at the end. The body lines up with the title.

type.note: single keeps one item open; opening another closes it. multiple lets any number stay open.

defaultOpen.note: Item id (or ids with type multiple) that start open. Omit to start all closed. With type single only the first id opens.

requirements: Each header is a button with aria-expanded
Panel is role=region, aria-labelledby its header
Closed panels are hidden from AT
Down and Up move focus between headers (Home and End jump to the ends); Right opens, Left closes
Disabled items set aria-disabled, cannot toggle, and are skipped by Tab and arrow keys

doNot: Do not invent local Accordion or Collapse — use Collapsible for one block
snippet: <Accordion items={[{ id: 'hours', title: 'Hours', content: 'Weekdays 9–5.' }, { id: 'address', title: 'Address', content: 'Knez Mihailova 1.' }]} defaultOpen="hours" />
